meta.title: LowBatteryTown · Just Sit For A While
meta.description: A LowBatteryTown interactive prototype: how many bars are left today? Pick your social battery and try a low-pressure anonymous chat with no sign-up. Matching and replies are simulated for now.
meta.keywords: LowBatteryTown,low social battery,anonymous chat,low-pressure chat,chat with strangers
meta.ogAlt: LowBatteryTown: a deep-blue night town with street lamps and an expressive animated battery

home.eyebrow: OPEN WHEN YOU NEED A LITTLE COMPANY
home.kicker: A town for people running low on battery
home.subtitleA: No need to plan what to say. Pick how you feel right now,

low.name: Nearly out
low.title: Nearly out is okay, too.
low.description: You can say less today. You don't have to keep finding topics here.
low.pace: Replies may be slow, and saying less is fine.

mid.name: A little left
mid.title: Slow and steady is just right.
mid.description: No rush to get to know anyone. A simple hello is enough.
mid.pace: Happy to go slow. No need to reply quickly.

high.name: Up for a chat
high.title: Got something to say? Say it.
high.description: The street lamps are on tonight, a good time to share a story.
high.pace: Feeling brighter today and up for more conversation.

casual.normal: Hi {nickname}, I'm {partner}. How was your day?
casual.low: Hi {nickname}, I'm {partner}. It looks like your battery is low, so let's take it slowly. How was your day?

listen.normal: Hi {nickname}, I'm {partner}. Anything on your mind today? I'm listening.
listen.low: Hi {nickname}, I'm {partner}. It looks like your battery is low, so let's take it slowly. Anything on your mind today? I'm listening.

replies.understand: I get that. Sitting here and chatting for a bit feels nice today.
replies.think: That's an interesting question. Let me think about it slowly.
replies.thanks: Thank you for sharing that. You can go at your own pace.
replies.similar: I see. I felt something a bit similar today.
replies.listening: Mm, I'm listening. Is there anything else you'd like to say?

topics.song: Is there a song lately that sounds like how you feel?
topics.quiet: Which quiet moment of the day do you like best?
topics.story: Would you rather hear a story or share one today?

waiting.eyebrow: A LITTLE SPACE BETWEEN HELLO AND HELLO
waiting.titleBottom: Waiting for someone to walk over.
waiting.breathe: Take a slow breath. No need to prepare an opening line.

chat.topicLabel: The lamp passes you a card

system.extendAccepted: They'd like to stay too. You have 7 more minutes.

aside.label: A NOTE FROM TOWN
aside.body: There are no read receipts and no pressure to reply first. When you want to stop, press "Say good night".
aside.hint: Both of you need to agree.
aside.hintPending: Prototype demo: the other side will agree.

end.bodyTop: The conversation has ended, and the street lamps stay on.
end.bodyBottom: Come back and sit for a while whenever you feel like talking.

about.title: Just sit for a while.
about.body: Pick today's social battery, then chat with a stranger for 7 minutes. If you both want to, you can stay longer. You can leave any time. This page is an interactive prototype, and matching and replies are simulated by the program.

report.title: Report conversation
report.body: Thank you for looking out for the town. The full service will offer reporting and blocking. The prototype has no real conversations, so nothing is sent right now.

timeUp.title: Time's up
timeUp.body: This conversation ends here for now. If you'd like to stay a little longer you can extend by 7 minutes, or say good night whenever you like.

support.title: Light a lamp for the town
support.intro: If you like it here, you can choose a one-time amount. Chat and matching are the same for everyone, and supporting doesn't unlock anything extra.
support.once: Pay once · no automatic renewal · supporting is optional
support.usage: Contributions are planned for running the site and handling reports. The live payment page will list the operator, a contact address, and payment and refund terms.
support.disclosure: Payments are not open in the prototype and no payment details are collected.

footer.left: LowBatteryTown · a town still being imagined
footer.right: Prototype demo: matching and messages are simulated and not connected to real people.
